raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Giorgi Shengelaia is older than Victor Schertzinger. The data gathered in previous steps clearly showed Victor Schertzinger was born in 1888 and Giorgi Shengelaia was born in 1937. Since 1888 is earlier than 1937, Victor Schertzinger is the older director. The Planner failed to correctly interpret the chronological relationship between the birth years, reversing the logic of the comparison (confusing "older" with "born later").
